description.en: A half-size solderless breadboard: 30 columns of two five-hole strips and four power rails.

sources.title: figures/engine/bench-bb.js: the half board geometry
sources.note: Lines 8-19 give 30 columns, 82.5 by 54.5 mm, a 2.54 mm pitch, the row heights and the rail columns.

summary.en: Holes in one strip conduct to each other. The rails run the full length of the board.
A conductor. The strips are joined by the nets the document holds for each leg, not by a solver element.

reason.en: The breadboard has no electrical behaviour of its own. Which holes are joined is the document netlist.

what_it_models.en: Each column half of five holes and each power rail is one conductor.

not_modelled.en: Contact resistance, stray capacitance between strips and the break in the middle of a long power rail.

text.en: The rails are continuous here. Some half-size boards split them; this one is modelled as unbroken.

tests.note: Checks the hole count, the strips and that every hole is in exactly one strip.
